card.title: MIG 3
card.text: If in your hand, this unit costs 2 less each time an enemy countermeasure triggers.
card.flavorText: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-3 was a Soviet fighter and interceptor aircraft used during WWII by the Soviet Air Force. The MiG-3 was built in large numbers in 1941-42 and at the beginning of Operation Barbarossa in June 1941, 981 aircraft were in Soviet service. However, due to the fact that the aircraft was designed for high-altitude combat it was difficult to use over the Eastern Front where aerial combat generally took place at low and medium altitudes. This made the the MiG-3 inferior, both to other Soviet and Allied contemporaries and the German Messerschmitt Bf 109. The Soviets also experimented with the MiG-3 as a fighter-bomber, but it was not suited for this role and before the end of WWII the aircraft was withdrawn from service. By that time 3,422 aircraft had been built and 1,432 of them had been shot down.
